properties.name: The confirmation ledger reads each artifact's history once, so loop_status is fast on a large design and fits flo2.io's 30 s door
properties.rationale: Anthony, 2026-10-09: "Fix the root cause", after phase 0 of moving reflow2's design onto flo2.io found loop_status over the gateway's 30 s door. See fact:the-confirmation-ledger-re-read-every-artifacts-history-once-per-capability-2026-10-09.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: confirmation_ledger now computes each artifact's claims and each accepting event's classification once per ledger, and sums them per capability; its output is unchanged. On reflow2's design the ledger goes from 17.4 s to 0.26 s. loop_status on flo2.io's hardware goes from 46.3 s cold and 30.8 s warm to 11.7 s and 0.8 s. A stale comment in coherence.rs about incoming() is corrected.
